VIX 是标普 30 天期权隐含波动率。走高 = 期权市场为未来一个月的大幅波动: VIX is the 30-day implied volatility of S&P 500 options. Rising VIX means the options market is paying more for a big move over the next month, usually driven by three forces: institutions buying protection in size, dealers forced to hedge, and the spot index itself starting to move violently.
近月(30天)波动率除以远月(93天)。正常牛市里远月更贵(contango，比: Near-term (30-day) volatility divided by far-term (93-day). In a normal bull market the far leg is more expensive (contango, ratio around 0.85) because uncertainty accumulates with time. A spike in the ratio means fear is concentrated in the coming month — hedging money is bidding the front end. That is pricing for 'something is about to happen', not for 'things get worse over time'. Above 1.0 is inversion, which has marked the start of several crises precisely.
SKEW 衡量深度虚值看跌期权相对平值的贵贱，也就是市场为'黑天鹅'付的溢价。它: SKEW measures how expensive deep out-of-the-money puts are relative to at-the-money — in effect the premium the market pays for a black swan. A high reading means someone is buying far-downside protection. Caveat: SKEW spends most of its life between 135 and 155, so a high print alone does not mean a crash is coming. It says 'insurance got expensive'; only with VIX rising alongside does it become a double confirmation.
MOVE 是美债版的 VIX，衡量国债期权隐含波动率。债市是所有资产的定价锚，M: MOVE is the Treasury market's VIX, measuring implied volatility in government bond options. The bond market is the pricing anchor for every asset, so a MOVE spike means the risk-free rate itself is unstable — which transmits into equities through three channels: discount rates, collateral valuation, and cross-asset risk budgets. Historically, bond volatility has peaked before equity volatility more often than not.
信用利差是最诚实的压力计。股票可以靠叙事撑估值，但债券持有人只关心能不能还上钱。: Credit spreads are the most honest stress gauge. Equities can hold a valuation on narrative alone, but bondholders only care whether they get paid back. Widening spreads mean the market is starting to doubt solvency — the precursor to 'the balance sheet is falling', not merely 'positions are falling'. That is exactly why no narrative-collapse event in this archive ever produced a V-shaped rebound.
10年减2年美债收益率。倒挂(<0)意味着市场认为短期利率高于长期——通常是货币: The 10-year minus 2-year Treasury yield. Inversion (below 0) means the market sees short rates above long rates — typically monetary policy has tightened too far and a recession is being priced. Note this is a slow indicator: the lag from inversion to recession has run 12-24 months, and the actual equity peak has usually come after the inversion ends and the curve re-steepens, not while it is inverted.
加密恐惧贪婪指数跌进 20 以下 = 极度恐惧。加密市场散户占比高、杠杆清算快，: A crypto Fear & Greed reading below 20 is extreme fear. Crypto has a high retail share and fast liquidation cascades, so sentiment mean-reverts far more strongly than in equities: historically the extreme-fear zone has more often been a local bottom than the start of a collapse. But that statistical regularity rests on data since 2018, covering only two complete cycles.
指数冲上 80 = 极度贪婪。这一端的风险在于它常与杠杆堆积同时出现(资金费率飙: A reading above 80 is extreme greed. The danger at this end is that it usually coincides with leverage build-up — funding rates spiking, open interest surging — which is the standard set-up for the leverage-stampede crashes catalogued in this archive.
用 BAA10Y(穆迪Baa企业债收益率-10年美债, FRED 1986起全量: BAA10Y (Moody's Baa corporate yield minus the 10-year Treasury, full history from 1986 on FRED) is used as a proxy for the high-yield spread. The real series, BAMLH0A0HYM2, is capped at the trailing three years on FRED's free CSV endpoint (the cosd/coed parameters are ignored — verified), so it cannot be backtested. Trigger levels here are therefore the proxy's own 85th/95th percentiles, not the 5.0%/8.0% HY OAS levels shown on the dashboard card.
